underdog.heading: Why Mercer can keep it close
bullets: The outcome range is 15.5 points wide at one sigma — p10 +7.9 to p90 +52.9 for Georgia Tech, so a projection of +31.9 still produces results a long way either side of it.
It is early enough that both ratings still lean on preseason belief — it widens the outcome range by about 6%.
70% of the model’s own input contract was empty for this game — no starter, injury, schedule or per-player talent context reached it, so the number leans on team strength more than it should.
Mercer is not in the FBS rating set, so EdgeDesk cannot measure what it does well. An unmeasured opponent is an unknown, not a weak one, and the size of the gap is not established.
